svg.title: System Map
svg.desc: System Map. One request and one event through a typical system: DNS, CDN, load balancer, gateway, services, cache, database, queue and search. Step 1, A page view: A page view: DNS, the CDN for images and scripts, then GET /products/42 answered from Redis. Step 2, An order, one transaction: POST /orders: one transaction writes order 1001 and an outbox row; 201 Created when it commits. Step 3, The event fans out: The relay publishes OrderPlaced; email, search and analytics each react, after the response. Step 4, Running it: Every box reports to observability. The indexer crashes: orders still work, search falls 3 behind.

g.text: A page view: DNS, the CDN for images and scripts, then GET /products/42 answered from Redis.
POST /orders: one transaction writes order 1001 and an outbox row; 201 Created when it commits.
The relay publishes OrderPlaced; email, search and analytics each react, after the response.
Every box reports to observability. The indexer crashes: orders still work, search falls 3 behind.
